sources.title: Flames' Joel Farabee: Stays hot with two points
Flames' Joel Farabee: Stays hot with two points

findings.note: An Oct 27, 2026 RotoWire/CBS update says Farabee scored a goal and an assist in Monday's 5-2 win over Toronto, which runs his point streak to five games, and gives him 11 points (six on the power play) in 11 games.

The Flames' recap of the Oct 22 win over Minnesota lists Farabee on the top line with Ben Jones and Matt Coronato, and says he leads Calgary forwards in shorthanded ice time, so he plays a lot in all situations.

This page notes Calgary's offensive struggles and shows Farabee had 38 points in 82 games last season, under a point per game. His game log includes a scoreless Oct 13 game, and preseason projections had him around 40 points.

ESPN's fantasy column from Oct. 27, 2026 recommends streaming Frost this week. It says he plays on Calgary's top power-play unit with Farabee, where four of his seven points have come, though his even-strength ice time has been limited to 13:50 a night over his last three games.

An Oct. 11, 2026 RotoWire note says Frost scored two of Calgary's seven goals across its first five games, with a minus-6 rating. It calls Calgary's offense one to avoid but confirms he gets steady top-six and power-play minutes.

A Sept. 20, 2026 report says Frost opened camp as Calgary's No. 1 center after scoring 43 points in 82 games last season, which points to more ice time. It also warns he shouldn't be expected to provide high-end value on what is expected to be one of the NHL's weaker teams.

This January 2026 Flyers piece says Dvorak was centering top scorers Trevor Zegras and Travis Konecny and was third on the team in scoring. It is about last season, though, and does not confirm his line or power-play role for the 2026-27 season or for tonight.
Dvorak had 25 points in his first 39 games of 2025-26, which beat his usual pace. Before that he was around 33 points per 82 games, so the stronger stretch could turn out to be temporary.

This July 2025 profile describes Dvorak as mainly a third-line, defense-first center and penalty killer who has mostly played on the second power-play unit. It also says he has had injuries in recent seasons, though he played all 82 games in 2024-25.

Oct 27, 2026 RotoWire: Farabee had a goal and an assist vs. Toronto, so he has points in five straight games (3 G, 5 A). He has 11 points in 11 games, six on the power play, which means about 8 assists so far.
Oct 23, 2026 RotoWire: Farabee is playing on Calgary's top line and first power-play unit. That role gives him more assist chances than his middle-six usage last season.

CBS game log shows assists in Oct 15, 18 and 24 games (two on Oct 24) and seven assists in his first 10 games. Searches found no injury news for him, but also nothing on Edmonton's lineup, goalie or analyst picks for this game.
